meta.name: game-brainstorm
meta.description: Invoke when the user wants to brainstorm game ideas, explore concepts, run structured ideation, or develop a new game concept from scratch. Triggers on: "game idea", "brainstorm", "concept", "ideation", "what if", "game concept", "pitch". Do NOT invoke for reviewing existing designs (use game-design-review) or market analysis (use game-market-research). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把零散想法变成可落地的游戏概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果脑子里有游戏想法但不知如何系统梳理
copy.tagline_en: Turn scattered ideas into actionable game concepts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have game ideas but need help structuring them

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你通过七个阶段来构思游戏概念，从情感探索到市场验证，逐步将模糊想法变成可执行的方案。它会不断提问，让你自己发现创意，而不是替你生成。
howto.when: 当你说出“游戏创意”、“头脑风暴”、“概念”等关键词，或想从零开发新游戏概念时触发。

say.text: 我想做一个关于时间旅行的游戏，但不知道从哪开始。
say.note: Claude 会启动创意发现阶段，引导你探索情感核心。

say.text: 帮我头脑风暴几个游戏概念，用动词优先法。
say.note: Claude 会使用动词优先设计技术生成候选概念。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through seven phases to brainstorm game concepts, from emotional exploration to market validation, turning vague ideas into executable plans. It asks questions to help you discover your own creativity, not generate ideas for you.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say keywords like "game idea", "brainstorm", "concept", or want to develop a new game concept from scratch.

say_en.text: I want to make a time travel game but don't know where to start.
say_en.note: Claude will start the Creative Discovery phase to explore emotional core.

say_en.text: Help me brainstorm game concepts using verb-first design.
say_en.note: Claude will use verb-first technique to generate candidate concepts.
